profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Austin, Texas, trading as DLR. Its website describes the company as delivering what it calls the world's largest data center platform, offering data center services, colocation, connectivity, and cloud services across a global ecosystem. The site says its facilities support deployments from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows, and that it is sustainably built for flexibility and open ecosystems.

The company's site states that AI is exposing infrastructure gaps, with inference loads and GPU demands pushing traditional environments to their limits. It promotes a 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, reporting that 40% of IT leaders cite infrastructure as an AI constraint and that enterprises are moving from AI strategy to execution.

Texas records list 126 legal exposure entries involving the company. No specific product names or litigation details are provided in the available material.
